meta.title: List Assets
meta.summary: List account media assets with optional category and status filters. Returns asset IDs and lifecycle states for clone, generation, and processing workflow pickers.

hero.title: List Assets
hero.summary: List account media assets with optional category and status filters. Returns asset IDs and lifecycle states for clone, generation, and processing workflow pickers.

endpoint_summary.summary: List assets for the current user.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Try it lists the current account's assets.
Use the category filter to narrow reusable asset types.

fields.name: category
fields.description:
. assethpb.Category:\
... enums:\
..... CATEGORY_UNDEFINED\
..... MEDIA\
..... AVATAR\
..... VOICE

fields.name: status
fields.description:
. assethpb.Status:\
... enums:\
..... STATUS_UNDEFINED\
..... PROCESSING\
..... ACTIVE\
..... LOCKED\
..... EXPIRING_SOON\
..... EXPIRED\
..... DELETED

fields.name: code
fields.description:
response code enums:\
.. 0: ok\
.. 12: invalid input\
.. 13: unauthenticated\
.. 99: server error
